backup.production_rule: SINGLE SHOT: the migration is not re-runnable. A second run stops on its own md5 guard by design (get_inventory_catalogue_v1 is no longer the body it was cut from); to undo, apply the rollback. Apply AFTER s82_staff_31_20261015 and s82_checklist_20261015. The first block stops (55000, nothing changed) unless get_inventory_catalogue_v1 is exactly the body this release was cut from (md5 of prosrc, CR stripped: 07c22913a8cf0148d6f79f282d1585d1, read from production 2026-10-14). Another lane's migration 20261017010000 may apply in the same window: this release touches no calendar object and not admin_stays_v1. Additive except one function body, one revoke and one publication change: (1) MONEY / PRIVACY LEAK CLOSED: authenticated loses table-wide SELECT on inventory_items and gets SELECT on every column except unit_cost (a cleaner could read the cost over REST through policy inventory_staff_read); INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE and both policies unchanged; the service role keeps everything; unit_cost is readable only through get_inventory_catalogue_v1 for finance_human_authorized sessions; inventory_items leaves the supabase_realtime publication (no app subscribes). Callers checked 2026-10-14: the admin dashboard reads inventory_items with select('id, name') and select('id, name, category, qty_on_hand, unit') only, the checklist and staff app read no cost, edge functions use the service role, the two invoker-rights functions (match_inventory_item, apply_inventory_purchase) name no unit_cost; (2) inventory_items.par_qty (nullable, 0 up to 100,000,000); (3) table inventory_item_codes (RLS on, no client grant; one code per property maps to one item); (4) get_inventory_catalogue_v1 = the live body plus per-item `par` and `codes` (every read_operations role; unitCost rule unchanged); (5) five security-definer RPCs, signed-in users only, each gated inside: inventory_code_attach_v1 / inventory_code_detach_v1 / inventory_item_create_v1 / inventory_item_update_v1 (manage_inventory: owner, admin) and inventory_item_price_set_v1 (read_finance: owner, admin, finance). A new item's first count goes through reconcile_inventory_baseline_v1 (movement-controlled from day one); inventory_item_update_v1 refuses unit_cost and qty_on_hand. Rehearsal NOT yet run: see approvals / stop_conditions. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs).
backup.notes: Deploy order: SQL first, then the staff app (stock module probes the five RPCs and the par / codes keys and hides what is absent), then the inventory-report function (waves). Nothing in the admin dashboard needs to change first: it never reads unit_cost directly. No new secret.

rollback.safe_until: always. The rollback restores get_inventory_catalogue_v1 to the exact body this release was cut from, drops the five RPCs, the codes table and par_qty, gives authenticated table-wide SELECT back and puts the table back in the realtime publication. Lost: every barcode link and every par_qty value. Items created and prices set through the new RPCs stay (they are ordinary inventory rows).
